title: Serre's criterion for normality
statement: Let $R$ be a Noetherian ring [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring]. Then $R$ is a normal ring [def-weil-pbc-normal-ring] (every localization $R_{\mathfrak p}$ at a prime is a normal domain) if and only if $R$ has properties $(R_1)$ and $(S_2)$ [def-weil-pbc-serre-conditions-rk-sk].

source.place: Algebra, Lemma Tag 031S (lemma-criterion-normal, line 43977), Serre's criterion for normality (EGA IV, Theorem 5.8.6), and its proof (via Lemma Tag 031R lemma-criterion-reduced, Tag 00PD lemma-characterize-dvr, Tag 0BHZ lemma-hart-serre-loc-thm, Tag 030C lemma-characterize-reduced-ring-normal)
